name: @gauzy/mcp
description: Ever Gauzy MCP Server - Standalone Model Context Protocol Server

scripts.build: node init && npx rimraf build && npx tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.build:prod: node init && yarn nx build mcp --configuration=production
scripts.build:dev: node init && yarn nx build mcp --configuration=development
scripts.start: node init && yarn nx serve mcp
